remainingOpenDefect.label: Colorado Bureau of Investigation records to be sealed (selection)
remainingOpenDefect.whyItCouldNotBeClosedHere: The shared finalizer applies rcap-field-semantics.mjs protect rules to a selection's caption before it will mark it, and this caption matches the shared `agency` rule. Closing it needs one additive caption entry in PARTICIPANT_STATED_SUBJECT in scripts/rcap-official-forms/rcap-field-semantics.mjs. That module is shared by every official-form family in the fleet, including four other Colorado families held by other lanes (co_petition_seal_arrest-set, co_multiple_conviction_seal-set, co_decriminalized_conduct_seal-set, co_pardoned_conviction_seal-set), and a caption-anchored exemption there would change their next build without their lanes having asked for it. This dispatch is a repair lane with an explicit no-sweep instruction, so the change is named here rather than made.
remainingOpenDefect.whatTheEntryWouldLookLike: { id: "co_jdf478_cbi_required_record_holder", match: /colorado bureau of investigation \(required\)/, exempts: ["agency"], because: "JDF 478 section 3 prints the CBI line as (required) with its address, and section 5 directs the clerk to send the CBI a copy of the signed order. The line is the form's own requirement, not an agency certification the participant may not make." } - offered as a description of the shape, not as a change made here.
remainingOpenDefect.doNotCertifyItClosed: This counter is 1 in the committed reports/completeness-counters.json and this return does not claim otherwise.

directionalRasterDifferenceOnTheDelivere.method: pdftoppm -r 150 -gray -png on the two delivered fixtures and on both pinned sources, then a per-page dark-pixel difference at threshold 200 in BOTH directions, with connected-component analysis of the added ink and each component tested against the declared write rects in reports/actual-writes.json.
directionalRasterDifferenceOnTheDelivere.negativeControlResult: Three of the five pages of each fixture -- JDF-477 pages 2 and 3 and JDF-478 page 2 -- are pages this packet writes nothing on. Each gained exactly 0 dark pixels and lost exactly 0. JDF-477 page 2 is the page carrying the issuer's own CBI tick at 8C.0, so that control also proves the source-authored mark is materialised once and is not doubled or re-stamped.
directionalRasterDifferenceOnTheDelivere.removedInkFinding: ZERO removed dark pixels on every page of both fixtures. No ink the form draws was suppressed, and nothing was removed near a signature, notary or jurat area.
directionalRasterDifferenceOnTheDelivere.clusterShapeCheck: Every added connected component is glyph-shaped: 6 to 9 points on a side with 0.35 to 0.53 fill, and every one falls inside a declared text write rect. No hollow rectangle at a widget /Rect appears in the added ink on any page, which is the raster half of the byte accounting above.
directionalRasterDifferenceOnTheDelivere.difference between counted and total add: The small gap between addedDarkPixels and the sum of counted clusters is components under the 10-pixel floor (antialiasing fringe), not ink at a separate location; the outside-rect count is computed over every counted component and is 0.

measurementsThatContradictARecordInThisR.record: The official Colorado guide for this exact route, JDF 491 (Guide to Sealing Non-Conviction Records, simplified process), sha256 79dca4e720161b68ae74a8973392bbe22c05f565f704c609ec7cc7da0fcd3685, held at STATES/CO/03_INSTRUCTIONS in the mounted Master Library, versus data/record-clearing/legal-design-packet-set-manifests.json packetSets[co_motion_seal_nonconviction-set].components
measurementsThatContradictARecordInThisR.whatIMeasured: JDF 491 page 1, under its printed heading 'File the Request - File these forms into your criminal case', lists FOUR forms: 'JDF 477 Motion', 'JDF 492 Order (just do §§ A-C)', 'JDF 493 Notice (Just do §§ A-C)' and 'JDF 478 Order (just do §§ A-C)'. Read with pdftotext -layout from the pinned bytes.
measurementsThatContradictARecordInThisR.whatTheManifestSays: The packet set carries two components, JDF-477 and JDF-478, and records no missing component and no packetSetCompleteness entry at all.
measurementsThatContradictARecordInThisR.whyItMatters: This is the same four-document shape the sibling co_motion_seal_conviction-set is currently FAIL_REPAIR_REQUIRED on COMPONENT_SET for, and on that sibling the manifest records the gap in detail. Here the gap is not recorded anywhere. If the conviction half owes a notice and a second order, the non-conviction half owes JDF 493 and JDF 492 on the same evidence from its own guide. Neither JDF 492 nor JDF 493 appears in the mounted Master Library's STATES/CO/02_PACKET_FORMS directory.
measurementsThatContradictARecordInThisR.notActedOn: This lane did not open a COMPONENT_SET finding on this family, did not change the manifest, and did not build anything from JDF 491.
